approaches.name: DDPM-style denoising
approaches.problem: Directly turning random noise into a clean image is too hard as one step.
approaches.how_it_works: Add known noise to real images during training, then train a model to predict and remove that noise at many noise levels.
approaches.why_it_matters: It turns generation into many small supervised cleanup problems with clear targets.
approaches.failure_mode: Sampling can be slow, and errors at early high-noise steps can shape the whole output badly.

approaches.name: Noise scheduling
approaches.problem: The model needs to learn every stage between clean data and pure noise.
approaches.how_it_works: Choose how much noise is added at each time step so training covers light, medium, and heavy corruption.
approaches.why_it_matters: The schedule decides which denoising stages the model practices and how hard each stage is.
approaches.failure_mode: A poor schedule can make some stages too easy, too hard, or undertrained.

approaches.name: Score matching
approaches.problem: The full data probability is hard to know, but local directions toward data can be learned.
approaches.how_it_works: Train a model to predict the gradient of log probability, which points toward more data-like regions.
approaches.why_it_matters: It lets sampling move by following local directions instead of evaluating the whole distribution.
approaches.failure_mode: Wrong local directions can accumulate during sampling and push samples into bad regions.

approaches.name: Denoising score matching
approaches.problem: The score of clean data is hard to supervise directly.
approaches.how_it_works: Add known noise to clean data and train the model to point from noisy samples back toward the clean-data structure.
approaches.why_it_matters: It converts an abstract probability-gradient idea into a practical training loss.
approaches.failure_mode: If the denoising setup does not cover the right noise levels, the sampler lacks reliable directions.

approaches.name: Flow matching
approaches.problem: Generation needs a smooth route from a simple distribution to the data distribution.
approaches.how_it_works: Train a model to predict a velocity field that tells each sample where to move at each time.
approaches.why_it_matters: It frames generation as following learned arrows, often with a simple squared-error loss.
approaches.failure_mode: Bad path choices or rough velocity fields can make sampling unstable or low quality.

approaches.name: ODE sampling
approaches.problem: A learned velocity field must be turned into an actual sample.
approaches.how_it_works: Start from noise and numerically integrate the equation dx/dt = v_theta(x,t) with small time steps.
approaches.why_it_matters: It gives a direct procedure for using the learned field to generate data.
approaches.failure_mode: Too few solver steps can be fast but inaccurate; too many steps can be expensive.

approaches.name: Latent diffusion
approaches.problem: Running diffusion in full pixel space is expensive.
approaches.how_it_works: Compress images into latent codes, run generation in that smaller space, then decode the result back to pixels.
approaches.why_it_matters: It reduces compute while keeping enough structure for high-quality images.
approaches.failure_mode: Compression can discard details or create decoder artifacts that generation cannot recover.

approaches.name: Classifier-free guidance
approaches.problem: The model must make outputs that match a condition, not only outputs that look realistic.
approaches.how_it_works: Compare conditional and unconditional predictions, then push the sampling update more strongly toward the condition.
approaches.why_it_matters: It gives a simple control knob for prompt following and conditional generation.
approaches.failure_mode: High guidance can reduce diversity, exaggerate features, or create unnatural artifacts.

approaches.name: U-Net denoising architecture
approaches.problem: The model must combine local image detail with broad context during denoising.
approaches.how_it_works: Use an encoder-decoder image network with skip connections that carry fine spatial detail across scales.
approaches.why_it_matters: It preserves detail while still allowing the model to reason about larger structure.
approaches.failure_mode: It can struggle with global relationships and can become heavy at large image sizes.

approaches.name: Diffusion transformer
approaches.problem: Large visual generators need global mixing and flexible conditioning.
approaches.how_it_works: Represent images or latents as patches and use attention blocks conditioned on time and prompts.
approaches.why_it_matters: Attention lets distant regions and text conditions interact during each update.
approaches.failure_mode: Memory and compute can grow quickly, and weak conditioning design can make the prompt ignored.

approaches.name: Time-sampled training
approaches.problem: The model must learn corrections for all stages of generation.
approaches.how_it_works: Randomly sample a time or noise level for each training example and train the model on that stage.
approaches.why_it_matters: It spreads training across early rough-structure steps and later detail-refinement steps.
approaches.failure_mode: Uneven time sampling can leave important parts of the generation path weak.

approaches.name: Sampler distillation
approaches.problem: Many-step sampling is too slow for some uses.
approaches.how_it_works: Train a new model or sampler to imitate the result of many cleanup steps using fewer larger steps.
approaches.why_it_matters: It can make generation faster enough for interactive products or large-scale use.
approaches.failure_mode: Fewer steps can lose detail, diversity, or prompt accuracy if the large moves are not reliable.

approaches.name: Distribution-level evaluation
approaches.problem: A generator should match the broad statistics of real data, not only produce one good example.
approaches.how_it_works: Compare generated and real samples using feature statistics or similar aggregate measurements.
approaches.why_it_matters: It gives a scalable signal for overall realism and coverage.
approaches.failure_mode: Aggregate scores can hide prompt failures, safety failures, and bad rare cases.

approaches.name: Prompt-alignment evaluation
approaches.problem: A realistic image is still wrong if it does not obey the request.
approaches.how_it_works: Check whether objects, counts, relations, styles, and constraints from the prompt appear in the output.
approaches.why_it_matters: It measures whether the model is controllable, not just visually plausible.
approaches.failure_mode: Automatic alignment checks can miss subtle errors or reward superficial keyword matching.

approaches.name: Fast generation methods
approaches.problem: High-quality diffusion and flow models can require too many sampling steps.
approaches.how_it_works: Change the solver, train a distilled model, or use consistency-style objectives so fewer updates are needed.
approaches.why_it_matters: Speed decides whether the model can be used interactively or at large scale.
approaches.failure_mode: Speedups can trade away detail, diversity, stability, or prompt following.

approaches.name: Video and 3D generative extensions
approaches.problem: Images alone do not handle time, motion, geometry, or viewpoint consistency.
approaches.how_it_works: Extend the generation path so samples remain coherent across frames, camera views, or 3D structure.
approaches.why_it_matters: It moves the same generation principles into richer outputs people actually want.
approaches.failure_mode: Each new dimension adds consistency failures: flicker in video, broken geometry in 3D, or unstable identity across views.
